title: Swing Through Grass
description: Swing through grass to hit mobs: attacks no longer get eaten by tall grass, ferns and plants, so your sword reaches the target through foliage. Lightweight, server-side, no client needed.
body:
[![JOIN_OUR_DISCORD](https://img.shields.io/badge/JOIN_OUR_DISCORD-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/HTkn94BXmA) [![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CURSEFORGE-F16436?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&logoColor=white)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/swing-through-grass)

Lets players hit entities through tall grass, ferns, and other non-colliding replaceable plants. When a player swings at a passable plant, the mod traces the attack ray behind it and redirects the hit to any attackable entity in range — solid blocks still block attacks as usual.

![Hit through grass!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7925be1c4d76adf5dcaaddd983c0e41d51e6e7b5.png)

**Server-side mod** (client installation is optional — vanilla clients can join and use it seamlessly). **Works perfectly in singleplayer** — just install it in your mods folder.

**📦 Free to use in any modpack** — public or private, no permission needed.

**🐞 Please report any bugs, errors, or feature suggestions on Discord:** https://discord.gg/HTkn94BXmA
